duas.title: Dua for Qurbani (Bismillah)
duas.introduction: Jundub bin Abdullah (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said that the sacrificer will sacrifice by saying ‘Bismillah-h’.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ثُمَّ خَطَبَ، ثُمَّ ذَبَحَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فَلْيَذْبَحْ أُخْرَى مَكَانَهَا، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَذْبَحْ فَلْيَذْبَحْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Jundab: On the day of Nahr the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the prayer and delivered the Khutba and then slaughtered the sacrifice and said, "Anybody who slaughtered (his sacrifice) before the prayer should slaughter another animal in lieu of it, and the one who has not yet slaughtered should slaughter the sacrifice mentioning Allah's name on it." [Bukhari: 985]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Qurbani (Bismillah)
benefits.description: Saying bismillah before qurbani brings Allah’s name to the act, making the sacrifice pure and full of blessings for every Muslim on eid al adha.
points: Bismillah in qurbani dua makes the sacrifice halal and accepted by Allah.
Saying bismillah meaning in the name of Allah brings Barakah in qurbani amal.
Dua for qurbani keeps the heart soft and reminds Muslims of Allah’s mercy.
Qurbani ki dua helps Muslims follow qurbani rules and sunnah in every step.
Bismillah before goat qurbani or bakra eid keeps zikr Allah alive in the heart.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Qurbani (Bismillah)
when_to_recite.description: This qurbani dua with bismillah brings Barakah and makes your qurbani Amal right, showing Iman and following qurbani rules on bakra eid and eid al adha with a clean heart.
points: Before starting the qurbani, say bismillah to begin your sacrifice in the name of Allah.
When holding the knife for goat qurbani, recite the qurbani dua for a proper Amal.
As you follow qurbani ka tarika, use bismillah meaning to keep your niyyah pure.
While teaching kids about qurbani rules, repeat bismillah in English for easy learning.
After finishing the sacrifice, remember bismillahi allahu akbar to thank Allah for Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Qurbani Dua
how_to_perform.description: Before you start the qurbani, saying the qurbani dua with Bismillah brings Barakah and makes your amal accepted. This simple Islamic dua is a must for every Muslim doing qurbani on Eid al Adha.
steps: At the time of qurbani, say bismillah with allahuakbar before you touch the knife.
When you stand by the animal, softly recite the qurbani dua for qurbani ka tarika.
While doing goat qurbani or any animal, keep bismillah in English meaning in your heart.
After the sacrifice, thank Allah and remember the qurbani rules and make more dua Muslim.
If you forget, say bismillah as soon as you remember to keep your qurbani ki dua complete.

duas.title: Dua for Slaughtering Animal (Bismillah Allahu Akbar)
duas.introduction: Anas (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) placed his feet on the two jaws of a goat with white and black horns and sacrificed him saying Bismillahi wAllahu akbar.
duas.translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great!

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ ضَحَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ، ذَبَحَهُمَا بِيَدِهِ، وَسَمَّى وَكَبَّرَ وَوَضَعَ رِجْلَهُ عَلَى صِفَاحِهِمَا‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) offered as sacrifices, two horned rams, black and white in color. He slaughtered them with his own hands and mentioned Allah's Name over them and said Takbir and put his foot on their sides. [Bukhari: 5565]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Slaughtering Animal (Bismillah Allahu Akbar)
benefits.description: Saying bismillah allahu akbar before slaughtering makes the act pure and brings Allah’s blessings, keeping the qurbani accepted and full of reward for every Muslim.
points: Bismillah allahu akbar in dua for slaughtering animal makes the meat halal.
This qurbani dua brings Barakah and keeps the amal clean in Allah’s eyes.
Saying allahu akbar reminds Muslims of Allah’s greatness and power in qurbani.
Bismillah allahu akbar helps Muslims follow qurbani takbeer and sunnah rules.
Dua for slaughtering animal keeps zikr Allah alive and hearts soft with mercy.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Slaughtering Animal (Bismillah Allahu Akbar)
when_to_recite.description: This dua for slaughtering animal with bismillah allahu akbar brings Barakah, keeps your Amal right, and follows the qurbani takbeer as you remember Allah’s name and greatness in every step.
points: Before touching the animal for qurbani, say bismillah allahu akbar to start with Iman.
When holding the knife, recite the dua for slaughtering animal for a halal sacrifice.
As you follow qurbani takbeer, use bismillahi allahu akbar to keep your niyyah clean.
While teaching kids what does allahu akbar mean, repeat this dua for easy learning.
After finishing the sacrifice, remember allahuakbar to thank Allah for His Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua for Slaughtering Animal
how_to_perform.description: When you do the qurbani, saying the dua for slaughtering animal with bismillah allahu akbar is a must for every Muslim. This masnoon dua brings Barakah and makes your qurbani accepted by Allah.
steps: Before touching the knife, say bismillah allahu akbar with full Iman and clear heart.
As you face the animal, softly recite the dua for slaughtering animal for qurbani takbeer.
While cutting, keep the meaning of allahu akbar in your mind and do zikr Allah.
After the sacrifice, thank Allah and make a Muslim prayer for your qurbani to be accepted.
If you forget, say bismillah allahu akbar as soon as you remember to complete your amal.

duas.title: Dua Before Sacrificing Animal (Qurbani Dua)
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اَللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi wAllahu 'Akbar [Allaahumma minka wa laka] Allaahumma taqabbal minnee
duas.translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great! [O Allah, from You and to You.] O Allah, accept it from me.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Before Sacrificing Animal (Qurbani Dua)
benefits.description: This dua for qurbani brings Allah’s name and greatness to the sacrifice, asking Him to accept the act and fill it with blessings for every Muslim on bakra eid.
points: Bismillah allahu akbar in qurbani dua makes the sacrifice halal and pure for Allah.
Dua for acceptance asks Allah to accept the qurbani and give more reward.
Qurbani ki dua keeps the heart humble and reminds Muslims of Allah’s mercy.
Saying this prayer for acceptance brings Barakah and makes amal strong in qurbani.
Dua for qurbani helps Muslims follow sunnah and keeps zikr Allah alive in every step.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Qurbani
when_to_recite.description: This dua for qurbani is said to bring Barakah and acceptance from Allah when you offer your sacrifice, making your Amal pure and your qurbani ki dua in English full of Iman and hope for reward.
points: Before starting the sacrifice, say bismillah allahu akbar as qurbani dua for Barakah.
When holding the animal for qurbani, recite the dua for qurbani to seek Allah’s acceptance.
Just before the knife touches, use the qurbani ki dua in English for pure Amal.
After making intention for qurbani, read this prayer for acceptance to please Allah.
While teaching kids about qurbani, share this masnoon dua to grow love for Islamic dua.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua for Qurbani
how_to_perform.description: Before you do the qurbani, this dua for qurbani helps your amal get Barakah and makes your sacrifice accepted by Allah. Reciting this qurbani dua with a clean heart is a big part of Eid al Adha for every Muslim.
steps: Stand by the animal, say bismillah allahu akbar and make your niyyah for qurbani dua.
As you hold the knife, softly recite the dua for acceptance and qurbani ki dua in English.
While doing the sacrifice, remember to say allaahumma taqabbal minnee with full hope.
After finishing, thank Allah and make a prayer for acceptance of your qurbani and zikr Allah.
If you forget, say bismillahi allahu akbar as soon as you remember to complete your amal.

duas.title: Dua at the Time of Slaughtering (Qurbani Dua)
duas.introduction: Prophet (ﷺ) used to say at the time of slaughter -
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi, Allah-humma Taqabbal min Muhammadin wa Al-i-Muhammadin, wa min Ummati Muhammadin
duas.translation:
In the name of Allah, O Allah, accept it from Muhammad, Muhammad's family and from Muhammad's Ummah (followers)

Then he sacrificed it.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ حَيْوَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ بِكَبْشٍ أَقْرَنَ يَطَأُ فِي سَوَادٍ وَيَبْرُكُ فِي سَوَادٍ وَيَنْظُرُ فِي سَوَادٍ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ لِيُضَحِّيَ بِهِ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ هَلُمِّي الْمُدْيَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اشْحَذِيهَا بِحَجَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَتْ ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا وَأَخَذَ الْكَبْشَ فَأَضْجَعَهُ ثُمَّ ذَبَحَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ضَحَّى بِهِ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that a ram with black legs, black belly and black (circles) round the eyes should be brought to him, so that he should sacrifice it. He said to 'A'isha: Give me the large knife, and then said: Sharpen it on a stone. She did that. He then took it (the knife) and then the ram; he placed it on the ground and then sacrificed it, saying: Bismillah, Allah-humma Taqabbal min Muhammadin wa Al-i-Muhammadin, wa min Ummati Muhammadin (In the name of Allah," O Allah, accept [this sacrifice] on behalf of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad and the Umma of Muhammad" ). [Muslim: 1967]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua at the Time of Slaughtering (Qurbani Dua)
benefits.description: This qurbani ki dua asks Allah to accept the sacrifice for Prophet Muhammad, his family, and the whole ummah, filling the act with blessings and unity for every Muslim.
points: Bismillah in qurbani dua makes the sacrifice halal and pure for Allah’s sake.
Dua for acceptance brings Barakah and reward for the whole ummah of Muhammad.
Qurbani ki dua keeps the heart soft and reminds Muslims of unity in the ummah.
Saying this prayer for acceptance asks Allah to accept qurbani from all Muslims.
Dua for qurbani at eid al adha feast of sacrifice keeps zikr Allah alive in hearts.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Qurbani Ki Dua
when_to_recite.description: This qurbani ki dua is recited to ask Allah for Barakah and acceptance for yourself, your family, and the whole Ummah, making your Eid al Adha feast of sacrifice full of Amal and Iman.
points: At the moment of slaughtering, say bismillah and qurbani ki dua for acceptance.
When making intention for qurbani, use this dua for ummah to include all Muslims.
Before touching the knife, recite qurbani dua to seek Barakah for your Amal.
After gathering family for Eid al Adha, read this prayer for acceptance together.
While teaching kids about qurbani, share this masnoon dua to grow love for Islamic dua.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Qurbani ki Dua
how_to_perform.description: When you do the qurbani, this qurbani ki dua brings Barakah and asks Allah to accept your sacrifice for the whole Ummah. It is a simple Islamic dua every Muslim should say during the Eid al Adha feast of sacrifice.
steps: Stand by the animal, say bismillah and make your niyyah for qurbani dua with pure heart.
As you hold the knife, recite the qurbani ki dua for acceptance for all Muslims and family.
While doing the sacrifice, remember to say dua for ummah and ask Allah for Barakah.
After finishing, thank Allah and make a prayer for acceptance for the whole Ummah.
If you forget, say bismillah as soon as you remember to complete your amal and qurbani.

duas.title: Dua for Sacrificing Animal
duas.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say during the slaughter-
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ هَذَا عَنِّي وَعَمَّنْ لَمْ يُضَحِّ مِنْ أُمَّتِي
duas.transliteration: Bismillah-hi wallahu akbaru haza 'anni wa amman lam udahh-hi min ummati
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, Allah is Most Great. This is from me and from those who did not sacrifice from my community.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي الإِسْكَنْدَرَانِيَّ - عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الأَضْحَى بِالْمُصَلَّى فَلَمَّا قَضَى خُطْبَتَهُ نَزَلَ مِنْ مِنْبَرِهِ وَأُتِيَ بِكَبْشٍ فَذَبَحَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ هَذَا عَنِّي وَعَمَّنْ لَمْ يُضَحِّ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: I witnessed sacrificing along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at the place of prayer. When he finished his sermon, he descended from his pulpit, and a ram was brought to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slaughtered it with his hand, and said: In the name of Allah, Allah, is Most Great. This is from me and from those who did not sacrifice from my community. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 2810]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Sacrificing Animal
benefits.description: This dua for qurbani ki niyat brings blessings and acceptance from Allah, making the act of sacrifice during eid ul adha festival of sacrifice more meaningful for every Muslim.
points: Qurbani ki niyat with bismillah allahu akbar brings Barakah in the sacrifice.
Kurbani ka dua helps Muslims get reward for themselves and their ummah.
Saying qurbani dua makes the amal accepted as a true act of obedience to Allah.
Dua for qurbani keeps the heart soft and reminds Muslims of Ibrahim’s Iman.
Prayer for acceptance in qurbani ki dua helps Muslims follow sunnah with sincerity.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Qurbani Ki Niyat
when_to_recite.description: This qurbani ki niyat is recited to make your Amal pure, asking Allah for Barakah and acceptance for yourself and those in the Ummah who could not offer qurbani during the Eid ul Adha festival of sacrifice.
points: Right before the sacrifice, say bismillah allahu akbar with qurbani ki niyat for Barakah.
When making intention for qurbani, use this kurbani ka dua to include the whole Ummah.
As you prepare the animal, recite qurbani ki dua to seek Allah’s mercy and acceptance.
After gathering family for Eid ul Adha, read this dua for qurbani to teach kids about Amal.
While remembering those who missed qurbani, make this prayer for acceptance for all Muslims.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua for Sacrificing Animal
how_to_perform.description: This dua is said during the qurbani ki niyat at the time of sacrifice, asking Allah to accept your qurbani and also for those in the ummah who could not do it. It is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and acceptance in your Amal during the blessed eid ul adha festival of sacrifice.
steps: Stand near the animal and with a clean heart, say bismillah allahu akbar before qurbani.
Make your qurbani ki niyat clear in your mind and softly recite the qurbani dua.
While holding the knife, say the full kurbani ka dua for qurbani and remember Allah’s name.
After the sacrifice, raise your hands and make a prayer for acceptance of your qurbani.
Share the meat with others and thank Allah for letting you do this Islamic dua on eid ul adha.
